updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling enforcement of DLP policies on sensitive data in prompts and preventing data leakage to untrusted cloud applications. This integration extends DLP protection to browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms, closing gaps in data protection across web and API traffic.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now consolidates the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing security teams to view and manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts in one location with preview capabilities for agent summaries and case details. Enhanced user profile details from Microsoft Entra (office location, employee type, department, last working date) and expanded note capabilities on alerts and cases improve investigative workflow and contextual analysis.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Expansion for Microsoft 365 Copilot Web Search Protection
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data detected in prompts for external web searches, providing real-time control to mitigate data leakage risks. This capability helps organizations prevent oversharing of sensitive information when users interact with Copilot's generative features.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is rolling out to government cloud environments to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitive data in prompts, blocking responses when sensitive information is detected. This control prevents sensitive data from being used for grounding in both Microsoft 365 and external web searches within regulated government tenants.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending the same classification and governance controls used for Microsoft 365 groups without requiring separate configuration. This unifies label management across group types and improves data governance consistency in identity-based resources.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard for DLP alerts displays mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to detect (MTTD), and mean time to respond (MTTR) metrics against configurable SLAs for high, medium, and low severity incidents. Administrators gain visibility into historical trends and top exposed sensitive information types, enabling better operational performance tracking and SLA compliance management.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: DLP now supports rule-based automation to automatically resolve predictable low-value alerts and tag alerts for routing, reducing triage queue burden and enabling more efficient alert management. Administrators can define rules once (e.g., resolve low-severity mail alerts to trusted partners or auto-tag alerts from specific departments) and have them applied to all matching new alerts automatically.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records for Exchange Online now include enriched metadata beyond sensitive information type matches, such as sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information, visible in both alerts and Activity Explorer. This enhancement provides administrators more context for compliance monitoring, incident investigation, and policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Capacity Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft is increasing maximum auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling faster classification and protection of larger data estates. This improvement helps organizations close labeling gaps and better prepare data for Microsoft 365 Copilot by applying sensitivity labels and protection settings to more files automatically.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Archive Action for OneDrive and SharePoint Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now include archiving actions within existing data retention policies to move inactive files in SharePoint Online and OneDrive to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This enhancement enables comprehensive governance across the full content lifecycle without requiring separate archiving workflows.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Hard Delete Capability with Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Microsoft is introducing hard delete functionality for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows to allow compliance admins to permanently remove sensitive content according to retention policies. The feature includes safeguards such as 93-day recycle bin retention to prevent inadvertent data loss from misconfigured policies.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides access to Exchange Online archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) in preparation for EWS Graph API deprecation scheduled for October 2026, enabling developers to manage archive data through a single unified interface. This migration ensures continuity for applications managing archive mailbox retention and lifecycle operations.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import Capability
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables direct migration of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and execution phases. This capability streamlines PST migration workflows for organizations modernizing from on-premises or cloud storage infrastructures.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191 Exchange Online Authentication Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online (CVE-2026-56191) allows unauthorized attackers to perform tampering over a network, potentially affecting mail security and message integrity. Organizations should apply available patches to remediate this authentication bypass risk.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825 Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault (CVE-2026-62825) allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network, potentially enabling unauthorized access to cryptographic keys and secrets. Organizations using Azure Key Vault for identity and encryption operations should apply security updates promptly.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275 Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization vulnerability in Azure DNS (CVE-2026-58275) allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network, potentially compromising DNS resolution and service availability. This affects organizations using Azure DNS for infrastructure and identity service name resolution.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835 Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Online Services (CVE-2026-62835) allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network, potentially exposing tenant data or configuration details. This affects multiple Microsoft cloud services and requires timely patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163 Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication in Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (CVE-2026-56163) allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations running Kubernetes workloads in Azure should apply patches to prevent unauthorized cluster access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56160 Azure Red Hat OpenShift Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift (CVE-2026-56160) allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network, potentially enabling unauthorized access to cluster resources. Organizations using ARO for containerized workloads should apply security updates.
